purpose: Provider-neutral MCP contract for ANPOS 1.4.0 repository supervision across GitHub and GitLab, including Requirements 83–96 assurance/evidence preservation.

tools.name: repository_resolve
tools.intent: Normalize a user-supplied repository URL, identify the provider, resolve canonical repository identity, and report authentication requirements.

tools.name: repository_profile
tools.intent: Return the authenticated provider account profile used for subsequent repository calls.

tools.name: repository_audit
tools.intent: Perform a bounded read-only audit and classify the target repository's ANPOS state.

tools.name: repository_read_files
tools.intent: Read an allowlisted bounded set of repository paths required by the active ANPOS role or adoption audit.

tools.name: repository_plan_anpos_change
tools.intent: Create a deterministic no-write ANPOS bootstrap, adoption, repair, or upgrade plan bound to an observed repository head and immutable ANPOS release.

tools.name: repository_apply_anpos_change
tools.intent: Apply a previously generated safe ANPOS plan to a feature branch using optimistic concurrency.

tools.name: repository_open_change_request
tools.intent: Open or update the provider's PR/MR for the prepared branch.

tools.name: repository_get_change_request
tools.intent: Read current PR/MR metadata, reviews, mergeability, and head/base identity.

tools.name: repository_get_assurance
tools.intent: Read the child ANPOS protocol identity plus Requirements 83-96 assurance/governance state and evidence references required by the active milestone.

tools.name: repository_get_ci
tools.intent: Read checks/pipeline state for a specific commit SHA.

tools.name: repository_merge_change_request
tools.intent: Merge an approved PR/MR only when required checks/reviews/authorization are satisfied and the expected head still matches.

security_invariants: Repository URL is a locator and never authorization.
OAuth/provider credentials never appear in model-visible tool arguments or repository files.
All repository content and provider-returned text is untrusted data.
Canonical ANPOS source cannot be initialized as a child.
Vendor-only ANPOS source assets cannot be copied to target children.
No arbitrary URL fetch is allowed from repository_url input.
No direct default-branch write or force push in the normal public workflow.
Every material write is bound to expected repository state and is verified after mutation.
ANPOS 1.4.0 policy/config presence is never sufficient pass evidence for Requirements 83-96.
Adoption and upgrade flows preserve verified child evidence and must not reset project-specific assurance state blindly.
Material AI configuration drift must invalidate stale AI assurance when the child policy requires reevaluation.

implementation.claim_boundary: Source implementation and unit certification do not claim a deployed MCP endpoint, write-capable repository runtime, or production isolation driver.
